notes: Net spend is -22.6% against a ~-30% target, and the gap has two stated causes rather than one unknown. (1) Only 69 of 200 requests routed cheap, because 57% of this seeded set is Rs.10,000+ traffic that the stakes threshold forces to the strong tier -- a corpus artefact, not a router failure. (2) No cache hit is modelled at all; the plan's conservative 20-45% range is deliberately not claimed because nothing in this build has measured one.
Generation is held fixed across both arms: identical model output, so every difference is Interlock's. Generation latency and billing are NOT observed.
